findings.region: Table J3, first Process/start column, every Level/stationary row
findings.observation: Level/stationary wraps within the final word as Level/stationar followed by a lone y on the next line. Numerical cells remain visible and correctly associated, but the repeated single-character continuation impairs readability.
findings.suggested_resolution: Widen the first column or use an explicitly defined shorter display label such as Level/stat.; preserve every numerical value.

observations: Corrected level-versus-increment premise, unit stationary variance, differenced-increment correlation, unconditional and conditional endpoint distributions, and the marginal-threshold formula are visible without missing mathematical glyphs or lost exponents.
Text explicitly distinguishes the absolute-level 95th percentile from the signed-level 95th percentile, and the conditional-endpoint oracle from the marginal endpoint rule and path-maximum oracle.
The section heading is followed by its text; Table J3 caption and full sixteen-row body remain together. No clipped numeric column or paragraph widow observed.
